_readme: Muse: read MUSE.md in the repo root before editing this file. Every job needs a breakdown (5 scores) and the odds are computed from model.factors weights. Do not type an odds number by hand.

model._note: Odds = sum(weight x score) / 100. Weights are tuned here, in one place. Change them only with a reason written in changeLog.
changeLog: 2026-11-17: Added a minimum-odds floor that steps up each month. Weights unchanged. Odds rise only by picking better-matched jobs, not by changing the scoring.

oddsNote: Odds are my estimate of the chance of an interview, based on how closely the posting matches the resume. They are not a prediction.
